THE PARCEL IN MID-AIR: a cloth-wrapped parcel caught at the top of its arc over open water between two boats, one small sprite figure side-on with an arm up, another leaning far out to catch, both reaching

THE MELON AT THE TOP: a bright orange melon hanging at the very top of its throw between two hulls, a small sprite figure below with both arms up, the fruit a perfect round silhouette against open sky
THE ROPE MID-CURVE: a coiled rope thrown between two hulls and caught mid-curve in the air, one small figure side-on at the far end with an arm out, the rope a wide lazy arc over the water
THE PULLEY BASKET: a laden basket swinging out from a high window on a pulley line, hanging halfway down over the canal, a tiny sprite figure above leaning from the sill holding the rope taut

THE HAT ON THE WATER: a wide-brimmed hat gone from a figure's head and skating flat across the water, a small sprite side-on with one arm out pointing after it, the hat a dark flat shape on bright water

THE PAPER CONE HANDOFF: a small sprite leaning far out over a gunwale holding a bright yellow paper cone across open water toward a figure on the next boat, both side-on and nearly touching fingertips
THE DOUBLE EXCHANGE: two hulls pulled side by side with a bundle going over the rail one way and a clay pot going back the other, two small sprite figures side-on each holding one end of something
THE POLE PUSH: a small figure pushing a long pole hard against a neighbour's hull to swing their loaded boat around, the hull visibly angled mid-turn, the pole bowing under the force

THE KETTLE POUR: a small sprite figure standing side-on with a copper kettle tipped low, the tea falling in flat gold pixel steps into a cup held by a second whole standing figure on the next deck, both small and side-on
THE LOWERED BUNDLE: a bulging cloth bundle being lowered by rope from one deck down to a waiting figure on a lower hull, the rope taut, the bundle mid-drop, both small sprites side-on and focused

THE LEANING BASKET STACK: a head-high stack of nested baskets leaning right over a gunwale, a small sprite grabbing hard for the topmost one, the whole boat heeled a little and the stack a wild diagonal
THE BIG STEP ABOARD: a boat tipped sharply by a figure mid-step onto the deck, bright water coming over one gunwale in a chunky pixel wave, a second small sprite holding onto the mast with both hands
THE ESCAPED MELON: a single bright green melon bobbing away downstream on its own, a small sprite side-on on the deck behind it with one arm out pointing, the melon already three boat-lengths clear

THE UMBRELLA LIFTING: a wide striped umbrella caught by a gust and turning inside out, its frame splayed open upward, a small sprite figure below holding the handle with both arms up, feet off the deck
THE LOADED BOAT PUSHING OFF: a heavily laden boat pushing away from the bank, its wake fanning out in flat pixel bands behind it, a small sprite figure side-on at the stern with the pole angled back

THE TINY FERRY POLING OUT: a narrow ferry poling out between two market stalls with only a clear wedge of water ahead of it, a single small sprite side-on driving the pole down, the hull at a slight angle
THE BOAT UNDER THE ARCH: a boat sliding in under a low bridge arch at the far edge of the canal, its tall cargo of stacked bamboo steamers just fitting, a tiny figure at the bow ducking low
THE FAST POLE-IN: a boat being poled in fast from the far end, two small sprite figures on the near boats leaning back to make room, the arriving hull already overlapping the dock's shadow

THE LIFTED LID: a lid lifted off a wide steamer basket and a bright white plume of steam going straight up past a red-tiled roof, a small sprite side-on holding the lid out to one side at arm's length
THE THROWN BUCKET: a full bucket swung out and its water thrown in a wide chunky pixel arc over the side of a hull, a small figure side-on mid-swing, the arc of water hanging clear of the boat

THE SCRUBBING SUDS: a stiff brush scrubbing hard down the side of a painted hull, a trail of white suds sliding down into the canal in thick pixel blobs, a small sprite figure side-on working the brush with both hands

THE CRATE SPLASH: a great blocky pixel splash going up where a crate just went into the canal, the crate still half-visible beneath, a tiny sprite figure at the edge leaning over with both arms forward
THE FLUNG SHUTTER: a bright blue shutter flung open on an upper storey overhead, a warm lit room showing behind it, a small sprite figure leaning far out over the sill looking down at the water below

THE BALCONY BASKET: a small basket on a long string being lowered from a balcony rail, swinging slightly mid-descent, a tiny sprite figure above leaning far over the rail to pay out the string hand over hand

THE HAULED LAUNDRY: a line of bright laundry being hauled in fast along its rope between two upper windows, the clothes swinging and bunching as they move, a small sprite side-on pulling hard with both arms
